name: Flint
overview: Scripture uses flint both literally and metaphorically to reveal God's provision and strength. The Lord’s miraculous care is shown as He brought water from the rock of flint in the wilderness and provided oil from the flinty rock, demonstrating His sustaining power in harsh conditions (Deuteronomy 8:15; 32:13). Psalm 114 further illustrates God’s transforming power by turning flint into a fountain of waters. Spiritually, flint symbolizes steadfastness and courage, as seen in Isaiah where the believer sets their face like flint, confident in God’s help, and in Ezekiel where God grants an unyielding resolve, making the forehead harder than flint to face opposition without fear.
